advice: Capture request ID, start/end timestamps, active subprocess-window ID/client, endpoint/model, content-free shape (message/tool counts, stream flag), status/latency/usage/cost, purpose enum, classifier version, and reason; classify client only from nonoverlapping windows and purpose only by in-memory exact source-confirmed title-marker matching, persisting neither prompt nor marker, with all other cases unknown and Phase 403 unchanged. Test reordered title requests, near-match/non-match prompts, zero persisted content, and overlapping/missing windows. Stop if windows overlap, matching requires persisting content, or prompt-derived text enters receipts.
